title: Instance
description: What this repository is, declared once at the root in cac.yaml. Upstream is the Company-as-Code project itself; a fork is a company running on it. The role decides how the framework/instance boundary is checked, and the framework pin records which upstream release a fork is on.

name.description: Human-readable name of the project or company.

role.description: 'upstream' publishes framework.lock.json from its own tree. 'fork' checks its tree against the lock it received.

namespace.description: Short prefix this instance puts on anything that could collide with upstream, such as hub module names. Upstream uses 'cac'.

version.description: The framework release this tree is on. In a fork, it is updated only by 'cac upgrade'.

upstream.description: Where the framework comes from. Informational.

deviations.description: Framework files this fork has deliberately changed. A declared deviation is reported but does not fail 'cac boundary check'; an undeclared one does. Upgrades stop at every deviation for a human to resolve.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the framework file.

reason.description: Why the fork carries this change instead of upstreaming it.

decision.description: Repo-relative path of the fork's decision record, usually under company/decisions/.
